title: Move rigid mesh binding onto resolved semantic IDs

comments.author: ChatGPT
comments.body: Added RigidMeshWeightAuthoring.Author overload taking sourcePartId directly and changed CreatureMeshGenerator to use ResolvedPartSnapshot.Id, removing the generator's raw Definition.FindPart lookup from mesh-asset binding. Kept the CreaturePart overload as a compatibility boundary rather than widening the refactor. Added direct semantic-ID parity coverage. Unity execution pending.
